releaseNotes: A secondary school now sees no Primary anywhere. The console filters all data at the source by school category, so classes, learners, subjects, marks, timetable, dashboard and level tabs only show your own ladder (Secondary: S1-S6, O-Level S1-S4 and A-Level S5-S6). Installs that never chose a school type are asked once on opening. Phones follow the same rule. Nothing is deleted; switching back restores everything.
